title: Paddle Planet
style: world jazz fusion, female lead vocal, kora brass and strings, 90 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball anthem, uplifting choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
One paddle. One planet.
Same game. Every shore.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Grip the paddle, feel the weight
Steady hands decide your fate
Wrist stays firm, elbow loose
Continental grip, that's your truth

[VERSE 2 - Turkish transliteration]
Raketi tut, agirligini hisset
Sakin eller kaderini belirler
Bilek sert, dirsek rahat
Kontinental tut, bu senin gercen

[VERSE 3 - Nepali transliteration]
Raket samaat, tyo bhaari mahsus gar
Shaant haatharule bhagya nirdharit garcha
Nistho kalagat, kuhino khukulo
Continental grip, yo tero satya ho

[CHORUS]
PADDLE - RAKET - RAKET - RAKET
GRIP IT RIGHT - HOLD YOUR LINE
PADDLE PLANET - EVERY COURT
STEADY HANDS - EVERY TIME

[VERSE 4 - Hungarian]
Fogd meg az utot, erzed a sulyt
Nyugott kezek dontik el a sorsodat
Csuklo szilar, konyok laza
Kontinentalis fogras, ez a te igazsagod

[VERSE 5 - Basque transliteration]
Hartu paleta, sentitu pisua
Esku lasaiek zure patua erabakitzen dute
Eskumuturra sendo, ukondoa libre
Continental heldulekua, hori da zure egia

[VERSE 6 - Swahili]
Shika raket, hisi uzito wake
Mikono tulivu inaamua hatima yako
Kifundo cha mkono imara, kiwiko laini
Mshiko wa bara moja, hiyo ndiyo ukweli wako

[CHORUS]
PADDLE - RAKET - RAKET - RAKET
GRIP IT RIGHT - HOLD YOUR LINE
PADDLE PLANET - EVERY COURT
STEADY HANDS - EVERY TIME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Turkish. Nepali. Hungarian. Basque. Swahili.
One grip. One game. One planet.
Continental. Always.

[FINAL CHORUS]
PADDLE - RAKET - RAKET - RAKET
GRIP IT RIGHT - HOLD YOUR LINE
PADDLE PLANET - EVERY COURT
STEADY HANDS - EVERY TIME
ONE PADDLE - ONE PLANET
HOLD THE LINE - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
One paddle. One planet.
Grip it and go.
